en: Colorized vintage postcard view over a small lake with rowboats and a decorative metal fence with climbing plants in the foreground. Across the water stands a large historic-looking lakeside building with two pointed red roofs/turrets, surrounded by many trees. The setting is park-like. Printed text at the top identifies the scene, and there is a handwritten greeting in German along the bottom margin.
